Audio primitives: sample formats, channel layouts, planar buffers.

Ports symphonia-core/src/audio/{mod,sample,channels,buf,conv}.rs and generic.rs. Storage is always planar (one seq per channel, frame i is planes[p][i]); interleaved data exists only at packet boundaries. 24-bit samples are LSB-aligned integers in 32-bit storage, exactly like Symphonia's u24/i24 semantics (i32 -> i24 is s >> 8).

Types

AudioBuffer[S] = object
  spec*: AudioSpec
  planes*: seq[seq[S]]
  numFrames*: int
  capacity*: int
Planar buffer: planes[p][i] is channel p, frame i. 
AudioSamples = object
  case format*: SampleFormat
  of sfU8:
    u8*: AudioBuffer[uint8]
  of sfU16:
    u16*: AudioBuffer[uint16]
  of sfU24:
    u24*: AudioBuffer[uint32]
  of sfU32:
    u32*: AudioBuffer[uint32]
  of sfS8:
    s8*: AudioBuffer[int8]
  of sfS16:
    s16*: AudioBuffer[int16]
  of sfS24:
    s24*: AudioBuffer[int32]
  of sfS32:
    s32*: AudioBuffer[int32]
  of sfF32:
    f32*: AudioBuffer[float32]
  of sfF64:
    f64*: AudioBuffer[float64]
Runtime-typed planar audio (Symphonia's GenericAudioBuffer). 
AudioSpec = object
  rate*: uint32
  channels*: Channels
ChannelKind = enum
  ckNone, ckPositioned, ckDiscrete
Channels = object
  case kind*: ChannelKind
  of ckPositioned:
    mask*: Position
  of ckDiscrete:
    count*: int
  of ckNone:
    nil
Channel assignment. Ambisonic/custom layouts (Symphonia's Ambisonic/Custom) arrive with the ALAC/AIFF phase; until then such streams decode to ckDiscrete. 
Position = uint64
Bitmask of speaker positions. Low 18 bits equal the WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE channel mask. 
SampleFormat = enum
  sfU8, sfU16, sfU24, sfU32, sfS8, sfS16, sfS24, sfS32, sfF32, sfF64
Order matches Symphonia for stable ordinals.
